assertion.statement: The Envoy metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_version is renamed to envoy_cilium_npds_version.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: Subject family for a metric name is not available; rename cannot be expressed with a same-family replacedBy.; applicability: Evidence does not state which environments consume the old metric; usage of metrics in dashboards/alerts is not visible as configuration.; consequence: Evidence only lists the metric rename under Changed Metrics and does not say what happens to consumers.
